en: A monochrome postcard image showing an ornate domed mosque complex with richly decorated exterior walls and a prominent, patterned main dome. A smaller dome and additional structures stand nearby, along with a slender minaret in the background. Low buildings and palm trees are visible on the horizon. Printed caption text at the top identifies the location as Alexandria and the Nebi Daniel Mosque, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.
